drift.statistic: rolling median of daily claimed/expected energy

data.weather: ERA5 via Open-Meteo archive API, hourly

community.market_note: alpha = share of the two plants' uncontracted output this community can buy; the rest goes to other buyers

grid_emissions_t_co2e.note: emissions of the grid power the hotel uses in hours its certificates do not cover, at the average life-cycle intensity of Türkiye's own generation in that hour (imports excluded)

notes.supply: modelled from ERA5 hourly weather at the plant coordinates (pvlib PVWatts; generic turbine curve)
notes.forecasts: Open-Meteo previous-runs API, *_previous_day1, i.e. issued the day before
notes.loads: synthetic, temperature-driven hotel and office profiles
